title: Microsoft Teams: expanded Markdown support in the compose box
notes: claim 52: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The rollout windows, compose-menu instructions and general Teams licensing requirement agree with Microsoft's sources. No Markdown-specific administrative setting or charge was found. The risk rationale should describe what the notice says rather than categorically asserting that there are no new data sources or autonomous actions.
